market.verdict: Mixed: isolated squeezes possible, nothing broad.

outlook.label: Favor puts
outlook.verdict: Weakest fifth of readings: the index's usual 3–4 week tailwind is largely absent — the best environment this tool has for the Bear board. The index itself still rises more often than not, so puts need a stock-specific breakdown, not a market bet.
notes: VIX 19.1 (+17% vs its 20-day avg), term structure 0.95
